features.title: Pocketed backrest for full support
features.text: Multiple cushion pockets cradle your upper and lower back, making long hours of sitting naturally comfortable.

features.title: Button detailing for classic style
features.text: Inspired by Chesterfield, the pulled buttons create gentle wrinkles, giving the sofa unique character and charm.

features.title: Generous rounded armrests
features.text: Wide, curved armrests let you rest comfortably in any posture, whether you’re lounging or chatting.

features.title: Soft yet firm seating balance
features.text: Designed with an S spring suspension system in the base frame, this sofa offers the perfect balance of gentle bounce and firm support, keeping you comfortably relaxed every time you sit.

features.title: Easy ground clearance
features.text: Rubberwood legs add stability and provide clearance that makes cleaning underneath effortless.
